summary.en: A scrolling area fades an edge only while more content waits beyond it: the top edge appears once you leave the start, the bottom edge disappears when you reach the end. A fade always means "there is more this way".
summary.id: Area scroll memudarkan sebuah tepi hanya selama masih ada konten di baliknya: tepi atas muncul begitu Anda meninggalkan awal, tepi bawah hilang saat Anda sampai di akhir. Pudaran selalu berarti "masih ada konten ke arah sini".

en.title: Service terms in a card
en.desc: Scroll the terms. At the start only the bottom edge fades; in the middle both do; at the end only the top.
en.html:
Business permit service terms

Applications are processed from the first of each month. Incomplete files are returned and must be completed within five working days, after which the application lapses. The help desk moves to Thursday afternoons while the service building is renovated. A jointly owned business needs one shared folder of documents and a short note on each owner's role. Photos of the business site are taken in daylight and show the sign board. If you cannot attend the site check, send a notice within three days and you get a new slot the following week. From week 3 a letter of domicile must be attached. The final check covers every document, especially the environmental and zoning ones.

en.title: A row of filter chips
en.desc: On narrow screens the chips scroll sideways; the right edge fades while more chips wait, the left once you have scrolled.

id.title: Ketentuan layanan di kartu
id.desc: Scroll ketentuannya. Di awal hanya tepi bawah yang memudar; di tengah keduanya; di akhir hanya tepi atas.
id.html:
Ketentuan layanan izin usaha

Permohonan diproses mulai tanggal 1 setiap bulan. Berkas yang kurang dikembalikan dan harus dilengkapi dalam lima hari kerja, setelah itu permohonan dianggap batal. Loket konsultasi pindah ke hari Kamis siang selama gedung pelayanan direnovasi. Usaha bersama perlu satu folder berkas dan catatan singkat tentang peran tiap pemilik. Foto lokasi usaha diambil pada siang hari dan menampilkan papan nama. Jika berhalangan hadir saat verifikasi lapangan, kirim pemberitahuan dalam tiga hari dan jadwal baru diberikan minggu berikutnya. Mulai minggu ketiga, surat keterangan domisili wajib dilampirkan. Pemeriksaan akhir mencakup semua dokumen, terutama dokumen lingkungan dan tata ruang.
